thread:
anya: Rapid sync on quota decay windows and metering granularity for reserved pools. Sales asked for hourly refunding of unused burst rather than daily; ops prefers daily to reduce churn. Need a compromise and clear UI behavior.

mike: Hourly carryover sounds great for customers but increases billing complexity and exporter load. Could we do a hybrid: sub-hourly meter (1m) but decay/carryover applied once per hour with a cap?

lucas: Hybrid works. Implementation: meter at 1m granularity, store rolling 1h usage, apply carryover credit snapshot at hour boundary. Carryover limit still 2x monthly allotment for pilot.

tess: For autoscale tie-breakers during slot pressure: prefer scale-down candidates by predicted 60s waste (if reclaiming saves < threshold, avoid evict). That reduces pointless churn.

mike: How do we estimate "predicted 60s waste"? use recent request arrival trend + active session count. Simple AR(2) prediction should be enough.

lucas: I'll add a small predictor to pool controller; expose confidence metric so we only trust predictions with >70% confidence.

anya: Also need a simulator to validate hourly snapshot vs daily snapshot for billing and latency. Can infra-bot create sim job with 5000 tenants, mix of bursty/steady, and run decay models?

infra-bot: auto: Created SIM-evc-9001. Params: 5k tenants, mix=burst(20%)/steady(60%)/chatty(20%), meter_granularities=[1m,5m,1h], decay_windows=[1h,24h]. Assigned lucas + tess.

mike: Console UX: show "next carryover snapshot" timestamp and projected credit if enabled. Also flag potential billing delta if switching from 24h->1h for pilot.

tess: Launch gating: require sim parity (latency delta <2% and billing variance <5% across top 10 customers) before enabling hourly snapshots.

anya: Action items: lucas implement predictor + exporter changes (PR by Wed), tess build sim scenarios (run by Thu), mike draft Console copy and billing warning (due Tue). We'll reconvene after sim runs to pick decay window.

anya: Thanks — keeping this tight so sales can give pilot option without surprises. :thumbsup:
